candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and 502 from /v1/orders and /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed. Gateway dependency metrics series empty.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: gateway POST /v1/checkout 502 after ~2s, order client ReadTimeout, inventory redis.reserve_inventory timeout with DependencyUnavailable, and 503 on /v1/reservations. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout at inventory.
